name: @extas/catalogue
description: The catalogue domain (S01): product, variant, colour and size model keyed by the ERP SKU (PR 19), the category tree with garment types (PR 20), the colour library (PR 30), structured fabric and care (PR 31), product naming and links (PR 590); the product admin, publish checklist, health score and publish queue (PR 21, 26, 29, 35); size charts (PR 27, 28) and Find My Size, rule-based (PR 58), collections and tags (PR 32), the catalogue CSV (PR 34) and the honest "was" price (PR 38).
